stateRules: Attendance is independent from appointment confirmation/lifecycle. Confirmed + checked in is a valid simultaneous presentation.
Clinical session start does not mark payment received; payment does not complete a session.
Appointment cancellation does not prove refund or message delivery.
Past appointment with no recorded completion remains Past · needs review, not Completed.
Selected/focused/hovered are presentation states, not domain status.
Slot chosen is not slot reserved or booking confirmed.
A timed-out operation remains unknown until authoritative status is checked; do not blind retry.
Saved local does not mean saved server or synchronized.
Expired inventory remains unavailable even if quantity is positive.
Source restrictions and policy values are observed demo behavior, not universal approved clinic policy.

Native page ledgers establish created sets, IDs, properties and bounds; screenshots and independent review establish inspected appearance.
Arabic content fixtures and future RTL templates are not a claim that all395 variants have full bilingual RTL behavior.
Icon masters and bound variables are local mirrors while cross-file libraries remain unpublished.

structural: Native components and component sets are editable with named variants/properties.
Repeated examples use component instances where actual cross-file/local links allow.
All source anchor colors retained and component token aliases resolve.
Component sets document content slots, disabled/pending/error/unknown semantics where applicable.
No sample fixture is presented as live patient, payment, messaging or authentication data.
rendered: No clipped labels, overlapping controls or unreadably small required information.
Focus/selection/error combinations retain contrast and identity.
Noto Sans Arabic displays actual Arabic without fallback or broken bidi.
Source logo geometry and clearspace remain intact.
runtime: Not claimed by Figma build. Browser implementation must verify keyboard, focus, assistive names/status, persistence, booking/payment/inventory exceptions and recovery.

notSuppliedPolicies: Actual clinic consent/legal copy and jurisdiction policy
Actual messaging integration and delivery guarantees
Real practitioner credentials, photos, customer testimonials or service medical claims

iconCoverage.scope: Every planned icon has an official source and native set ID; additional useful names are documented in source manifest.
